title: AlphaHunt
tagline: Fully on-chain product hunt using attestations and account abstraction
description:
AlphaHunt is a fully on-chain product discovery dapp. Using EAS to store user actions and account abstraction to significantly improve the user experience AlphaHunt makes it easy to discover and support new and interesting web3 projects. 

With AlphaHunt users can view projects and their details and support them similar to the popular tool "ProductHunt". The key differentiator is that all information is stored on-chain. There is no standard database with AlphaHunt, instead everything is stored as attestations and on IPFS.
how_its_made: This project uses AccountKit alongside the standard "Connect Wallet" UI to allow users to connect their wallet while still having their transactions sponsored. All actions on the dapp are stored as attestations that allow projects to see the on-chain record of who supported them. We built on base.
